I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the ticket is **#88412**. It's the Tier 2 escalation for the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet at Door 6, which freezes when scanning the bill-of-lading barcode. Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2025-07-02, and Hollis is a member of that channel. I also told Hollis not to confuse it with #8841, which is a different ticket about a Door 2 double-booking on Tobias's dealer account.

The gbrain search didn't run, so the answer comes only from channels Hollis belongs to. gbrain blocked the search because this connection isn't tied to any member. Whoever runs the gbrain server can fix that with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`.
